title: Blink Sound
blurb: Eyes do not make a noise when they close, which has never stopped anybody. The cartoon blink is a tiny wooden click, over in half a second, and it belongs to that category of invention animation taught us to accept as real. Now our brains supply it automatically whenever a character does a slow, confused double-take. Anime uses it constantly. So do meme edits, usually paired with a zoom on somebody processing terrible news in real time. It costs nothing to add and instantly makes a still frame feel animated.
origin: A cartoon and anime style eye-blink click, a standard of animation sound design.
